name: Circuit-Simulator
description: Free breadboard circuit simulator: LEDs, resistors, transistors, relays, sensors. 10 lessons, 60 quiz cards, 12 broken circuits. Four languages, works on tablets.

paragraphs: A breadboard circuit simulator that runs in the browser. Place parts on a breadboard, press Simulate, and watch currents, voltages and power. Built for learning electronics, with lessons, quiz cards and broken circuits to repair.
features: Breadboard: 30 columns, a-e and f-j strips split by the centre channel, and two power rails per side. Drag parts, tap to select, and undo with Ctrl+Z.
Parts (12): battery, resistor, LED (red, green, yellow, blue, white), diode, capacitor, push button, switch, NPN transistor, SPDT relay, photoresistor (LDR), NTC thermistor, potentiometer.
Burn mechanics: an LED without enough series resistance burns and stays burned. Overloaded resistors, diodes and transistors burn too. A burn cannot be undone.
Simulation: DC steady state with Newton iteration on diode and transistor models. Relays switch from their coil current with hysteresis. Shorts and "no power" are reported clearly.
10 lessons with presets you can load onto the board.
